findings.desc: managed-review-evidence import crash recovery: packages/main/src/handlers/managed-review-evidence.ts:262 seals evidence-binding.json before the ReviewPass is persisted at :273. If that write crashes and another managed receipt imports first, retry recomputes a different RP id and the immutable binding rejects it; the authentic receipt can never import. Recovery is therefore not idempotent across an intervening writer.

async EPIPE containment: packages/main/src/handlers/host-run.ts:443-461 stops draining outstanding writes after two seconds, then :654-658 removes both stream error listeners even if a write is still pending. A backpressured pipe that closes after that cap can emit an unhandled EPIPE and crash the foreground CLI, contrary to the documented containment guarantee.

readManifest.scanEscalationReason: Story-level changed surface is substantially larger than the candidate source set; review escalated into the managed-run, receipt-import, process-admission, command, documentation, and canonical-report paths.
